title: Chiefs land monster signing of two-time premiership star
desc:
Former Roosters star Joey Manu has signed with the PNG Chiefs on a two-year deal.
The Chiefs confirmed the signing of the 30-year-old cross-code star on Monday morning, ahead of the club’s entry into the NRL as the 19th franchise in 2028.
